projects.title: Maze of Fury – Unity FPS with AI Enemies
projects.description: "Maze of Fury" stands as a testament to the intersection of advanced game design principles, captivating narrative elements, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence implementations within the Unity 3D environment. Drawing inspiration from the adrenaline-fueled action of the Maze Runner movie franchise, this project aims to immerse players in a heart-pounding first-person shooting experience set within a labyrinthine maze.

Responsive and challenging enemy AI behavior
Fluid and responsive movement controls for precision navigation
Heart-pounding combat encounters with vampire enemies
Dynamic health system requiring strategic decision-making
Strategic cookie collection objectives throughout the maze
Optimized performance for smooth gameplay
Immersive visuals and atmospheric effects

projects.title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
projects.description: An autonomous vehicle simulation system built using CNN-based computer vision and behavioral cloning techniques. The simulator replicates what NVIDIA did in the simulation, allowing us to collect all our data from the simulator. The simulator has two modes: Training mode for data collection and Autonomous mode for testing the model.
features: CNN-based vision system for road analysis
Behavioral cloning from human driving data
Real-time steering angle prediction and speed control
Integration with Unity-based Udacity simulator
Two distinct tracks: Lake track and Jungle track
Training mode for data collection and autonomous mode for testing
Robust performance in various simulated road conditions
Comprehensive training pipeline with frame capture and analysis

experiences.title: Ai Automation Engineer
experiences.description: I engineered an end-to-end autonomous email sales agent using n8n and Notion AI that converts raw inbound buyer inquiries into completed transactions with zero manual intervention. Built on an event-driven n8n workflow, the system connects directly to a Notion-managed product and inventory database, leveraging Notion AI to parse complex customer requests, intelligently match SKUs, and dynamically generate accurate, itemized quotes. It handles conversational email negotiations autonomously, instantly provisions secure, pre-filled checkout payment links, and synchronizes transaction statuses back to the core database cutting lead-to-payment turnaround from hours to seconds.
